warehouses.description: The places that hold stock and ship Orders.
warehouses.formDescription: A short code identifies the Warehouse on stock screens, for example BEY-01.
warehouses.activeHint: A deactivated Warehouse keeps its history but receives no stock. It must be empty first.
warehouses.emptyDescription: Create the first Warehouse to start receiving stock.
warehouses.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: No Warehouses have been set up yet.

stock.description: On-hand, Reserved and Available for every Variant in every Warehouse.
stock.emptyDescription: Create Products and Warehouses, then receive stock.

movements.description: Every change to stock, with its cause. Balances always equal the sum of these movements.
movements.emptyDescription: Receiving stock records the first movement.

receipts.description: Stock arriving from suppliers. Each Receipt re-weights the Average cost.
receipts.search: Search by number or supplier reference
receipts.emptyDescription: Record stock arriving from a supplier.
receipts.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: No stock has been received yet.
receipts.newDescription: Choose the Warehouse, then add each Variant that arrived with its quantity and unit cost.
receipts.findVariant: Search a SKU or Product to add

productStock.title: Stock
productStock.description: Each Variant's stock in each Warehouse.

validation.codeFormat: Use 2 to 16 capital letters, digits or dashes.
validation.quantity: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
validation.unitCost: Enter a cost with at most four decimals.

adjust.title: Adjust stock
adjust.description: Correct On-hand for {{sku}} in {{warehouse}}. Use a negative quantity to remove units.

transfers.description: Move stock between Warehouses: send it from the source, then receive it at the destination.
transfers.title: Transfer stock
transfers.formDescription: Move {{sku}} out of {{warehouse}}. It stays a Draft until you send it.
transfers.sent: Transfer {{number}} sent; its units are in transit.
transfers.emptyDescription: Start a Transfer from a row on the Stock levels page.
transfers.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Transfers between Warehouses will appear here.
